revision_reason: The ordinary finer-mesh first flow solve stagnated near 8e-13 while pursuing the optional 1e-13 inner target. Version 2 uses the unchanged 1e-12 final momentum target internally and verifies the current flow before solving. Retain v1 smoke and diagnostic records; its other screen tasks were withheld before execution. All cases, controls, global acceptance criteria and comparison populations are unchanged.
scope: Separate forward and internal momentum policies; existing optimization and timing sources are unchanged.
selection: Freeze each family's policy after all 30 declared records are terminal. Rank by converged case count, then median elapsed time on commonly converged cases. Ties favor no acceleration, then shorter history. Retain missing/execution-failed records explicitly; never select using a partial screen.
physical_policy: Fixed signed controls, bounds and properties. Retain the 600-second horizon and smooth 60-second startup. Complete trajectories start from the original initial fields.
resolution_policy: Solver convergence is distinct from temporal/spatial resolution and bound satisfaction. Preserve the original 0.05 K and 1% tracking criteria; this study does not replace them.
failure_policy: All caps, failed solves and interrupted attempts remain visible. No failed solve enters a completed-solve speedup. Numerical failures do not trigger a relaxed accuracy target.
